name: Conveyor Bench — Demo Baseline: generated machine view
truthBoundary: Shows simulated physical truth (generated world raw image and entities) and observed PLC outputs from host-supplied snapshots. Not the PLC HMI and not evidence of PLC correctness. No credentials, network access or command authority.
layoutAssumptions: Scale is 180 px per metre for all paths; main lane runs horizontally at y=260 from x=70 (0 m) to x=826 (4.2 m); stations match equipment.json inferred demo geometry, not measured dimensions or PLC thresholds.

Each exit branch has 7 segments over its first 0.35 m (points every 0.05 m = 9 px) with heading increasing 6,12,18,24,30,36,36 degrees (6 degrees per step), then continues straight at 36 degrees; first point is exactly the main-path divert point and the drawn 36 px-wide chute follows the identical polyline.

Carton travel bands are treated as belt/chute width plus clearance: every static label and state lamp is at least about 40 user units from a centreline. Main photoeye lamps sit 48 units above the main centreline with labels above them; divert lamps sit in white callout boxes 88-158 units above the centreline with short leader lines to the paddle pivot.

Chute photoeye and ready lamps/labels are placed south-west of their chute in a nested counter-rotated (rotate -36) subgroup inside the rotateWithPath anchored group, so their text renders horizontal, roughly 60+ units from the chute and main centrelines, instead of diagonal text on the chute.

Divert callouts use two rows: title, then PLC/Home/Ext lamps each with one short label, then an isolated Pos row. Position values start at local x=-48 with empty space to the box edge, reserving room for unknown and up to 10 digits without touching any other label.
Side-panel numeric values are end-anchored at x=1170 reserving up to 10 digits (encoder worst case) away from their left-hand labels; speed/current/encoder text cannot grow into a neighbouring label.

Colour and source meaning: PLC observed outputs use violet stroke/fill via [data-cb-source=plc] selectors plus square lamps (and violet frames around stack lamps); world simulated truth uses teal stroke via [data-cb-source=world] plus circles. True PLC is purple, true world feedback is green, photoeyes amber, overload/not-ready red; false is pale solid and unknown is white with dashed stroke, visually distinct from false. A PLC command alone never paints a paddle or drive as physically moving.
Drive, encoder and stack light have no specified location and remain only in the clearly labelled side panel at x=948..1182, implying no measured location.
Divert paddles pivot at local (-18,-20) on the north lane edge: 0 percent lies along the edge, 100 percent rotates 50 degrees visibly across the main lane toward the 36 degree exit branch.

Carton template is 54 px (0.3 m at 180 px/m) by 32 px centred on its origin along +x; no carton is drawn statically. Belt marks repeat every 40 px, extend one period beyond each belt end, are clipped to the belt, and move only from the host Encoder_Count belt binding.
